blocks.orig: Moja Tuu Luxury Villas & Nature Retreat lies in Kiwengwa, in 27 acres of nature reserve, tucked between the Indian Ocean and a lush forest on the northeastern coast of Zanzibar. The resort boasts different rooms and private villas, the latter boasting 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, a kitchen and a private pool. All rooms are designed in typical Zanzibari style and fitted with locally handmade furniture, ensuite bathrooms, air-conditioning, a minibar, free Wi-Fi and a private terrace. The resort emphasizes sustainability; guests are welcome to use the bicycles and explore the island’s coral paths. There’s a beautiful infinity pool with ocean views, a bar and a restaurant. And families with children will love the Rafiki Kids Club!
blocks.html: In Kiwengwa on Zanzibar's northeastern coast, Moja Tuu Luxury Villas & Nature Retreat is set within 27 acres of nature reserve, nestled between the Indian Ocean and a green forest. You can choose from various rooms and private villas; each villa has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a kitchen and its own pool. Every room is decorated in classic Zanzibari style, with furniture handmade locally, an ensuite bathroom, air-conditioning, a minibar, free Wi-Fi and a private terrace. Sustainability is a priority here, and guests are free to take the bicycles and set off along the island’s coral paths. There’s a lovely infinity pool overlooking the ocean, as well as a bar and a restaurant. Families with children will also enjoy the Rafiki Kids Club!
